name: Protopasta Stainless Steel PLA @base
filament_notes:
Proto-Pasta data: 200C@24 mm3/s, 55C plate; FAQ range 195-220C (215C cited with a 0.5 mm nozzle). Avoid printing below 3 mm3/s.
Dense (2.3 g/cm3, ~90 m per 500 g) and brittle in spool form. Hardened brass or steel nozzle recommended for wear. Finish by wire brushing, tumbling, or buffing with compound.
